about: a stick's spring-back is not a press the other way (2026-11-23, the user: 'a phantom left input ... noticeable on select menu mostly'). A singles match, pad 1 Austin (the factory bindings: the d-pad's LEFT / RIGHT also on the left stick). Every 6 s: (A) the left stick right 300 ms, then left 30 ms at once -- a spring-back past the centre: '[pads] player 1: LEFT left out for a moment ... after RIGHT' and no 'real push' for it; (B) right 300 ms, then left 400 ms -- a real reversal: 'left out' then 'LEFT held 5x ms: a real push, it counts'; (C) the d-pad right 300 ms, then the d-pad left 30 ms: a real button, never touched -- no line. Read game_stderr.txt after the run (arcade_pads.cpp arcade_pads_snapback).
